maya_prod: Hey team — quick design review: Figma link (https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/usage-billing-v3) for the new Usage page. Main debate: compact sparkline + inline token totals vs. donut token breakdown in the right rail. Also thinking about where the invoice CTA lives when scope is org vs project. Thoughts?
josh_design: Thanks Maya! quick gut — donuts feel clearer for single-account breakdowns (percent + label) but sparklines win when users care about trend/context inline. Donut is noisy when there are 8+ token types.
anita_fe: From an implementation POV: donut requires canvas/svg and tooltip logic per segment. Sparkline + stacked mini-bars are much easier to virtualize for long lists. Also cheaper to animate on mobile.
liam_eng: Implementation + perf callout: if we have streaming usage updates we should avoid heavy SVG rerenders. Stacked bars (CSS + divs) + requestAnimationFrame throttling is simpler. If we do donut, memoize segments and only update numbers.
kate_a11y: Accessibility nits: donuts often lose meaning for screen reader users unless we provide detailed aria-labels and a table fallback. Checklist: 1) keyboard focusable legend 2) descriptive aria for each segment ("Model tokens: 23% = 12.3k tokens") 3) hover/active states mirrored to focus states. Also ensure contrast ratio for each color >= 4.5:1 if used as single-color indicator.
josh_design: Good point on fallback — propose a small accessible table hidden for sighted users but exposed to SRs. Also for color palette: avoid red/green pairings; use pattern fill for printing.
jenna_research: From last round of interviews, mid-market PMs wanted the token total upfront (top-left) and a small expand affordance for breakdown — they scan totals, then dig into trends. So keep total visible and make breakdown collapsible.
tom_pm: UX question: invoice CTA behavior — should 'Download invoice' be global (top right) or per-scope (inline on org/project header)? If user is in project scope they expect inline. If org scope, global makes sense. Maybe show both but disable the irrelevant one?
maya_prod: vote: show primary CTA in header (contextual to scope) + small per-row quick download for invoices next to each billing period. When in org scope, header CTA downloads consolidated invoice. Thoughts?
liam_eng: Fine with that. Only ask: avoid duplicative heavy downloads firing multiple times — debounce clicks server-side. Also add a confirmation toast with link to S3 when ready.
anita_fe: UI microcopy: instead of "Download invoice" maybe "Export invoice (PDF)" — clearer on file type. Also inline tooltip: "Includes charges for selected scope and date range."
kate_a11y: For the table fallback, add role=\"table\" semantics and ensure column headers are linked with aria-describedby. Example snippet: `role=\"table\" aria-label=\"Token breakdown table\"` and each row aria-labelledby=\"row-<id>\".
josh_design: color names we proposed: oak, saffron, lagoon, graphite. I'll share updated token palette in the figma file. Also I'll prototype a compact sparkline + toggle that swaps to donut on expand.
jenna_research: small datapoint: in tests users mis-clicked the donut legend expecting it to filter the chart. If we make legend interactive, show a hint "Click to filter" and make it keyboard operable.
tom_pm: Action items: josh to iterate sparkline + toggle, anita to spike implementation complexity and perf, kate to write a11y checklist and sample markup, liam to confirm streaming update strategy, jenna to pull interview notes on invoice placement. I can sync with legal about export audit logs.
maya_prod: thanks — can we aim for next Thurs for an updated figma and a short dev spike? :calendar:
deploy-bot: Note: staging deploy scheduled for 2025-06-03 02:00 UTC — please ensure experiments behind feature flag.
jenna_research: ack, I'll include the feature-flag in recruitment notes so we can test.
josh_design: +1 will upload iterations by Wed EOD :thumbsup:
